narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>In the second riddle the number is fifteen, because fifteen has the factors three and five.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>But the digits of fifteen are one and five, and they differ by four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The riddle needs a gap of one, so the factors are not enough on their own.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says the number is fifteen; the digits 1 and 5 are shown with a gap of 4 beside the clue one more; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, test your number against every clue in the riddle, and not only one.
<bookmark mark='ticks'/>Thirty five has factor seven and digits adding to eight, and forty five fits its clues too.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: 35 has factor 7 and digits adding to 8; 45 has factors 3 and 5 and digits differing by 1

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the number in the second riddle is fifteen, because fifteen has the factors three and five. The digits of fifteen are one and five, which differ by four and not by one, so the bubble is struck.
